summary: End-to-end testing of Lumen data platform. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases PASS including health, providers, real LLM chat via emergentintegrations, SSE streaming (GET /chat-stream), seed-demo task flow, dataset preview/list, Postgres warehouse (tables + SELECT query), analytics profile, chart generate, settings persistence (openai<->anthropic), system stats, LLM metrics, and generate-insights task completion. Frontend: Fixed missing /app/frontend/.env + vite.config.ts env-loading bug (frontend was calling http://localhost:8001 from the public origin). After fix, Insights/Data/Query/Dashboards/Reports/Settings all render with zero console errors. Verified: Generate Demo seeds dataset (260 rows x 8 cols), chat-mode streams real GPT-5.2 reply, agent-pipeline mode animates all 5 stages (ingestion → understanding → insight → visualization → report) and completes in ~3.5s, settings provider switch persists with success toast, theme toggle flips dark mode class.

minor.issue: Listing returns duplicate entries for the same seed (multiple UUIDs) and older entries lose cache → /datasets/{old_id}/preview returns 404. Consider deduping on filename/hash or pruning stale records.
Depends on in-memory cache (cache_service). If backend restarts, previously-seeded datasets 404 until re-seeded.

ui_bugs.issue: On load, TopBar auto-selects the first dataset (often a stale one w/o cached schema) and triggers /generate-insights/{id} + /insights/{id} which 404, showing a 'Failed to load insights' toast. Should pick the newest dataset with a valid schema, or fall back silently when none.
Size shows 'NaNMB' when size_bytes is missing.

issues: Save button partially overlapped by 'Settings saved' toast at bottom-right on 1920px viewport

action_items: Review /app/frontend/.env (newly created) and /app/frontend/vite.config.ts (updated to use loadEnv with REACT_APP_/VITE_ prefixes) — main agent should keep this config so preview/prod URLs are picked up correctly.
Dedup /api/v1/datasets listing and/or purge stale cache entries so the UI does not auto-select a 404 dataset.
Fix Insights page fallback when selected dataset has no insights yet (avoid user-facing error toast on first visit).
Fix NaNMB size display on Data Sources when size_bytes unknown.
critical_code_review_comments: vite.config.ts previously read process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL which is NOT populated by Vite's dotenv loader — fixed by switching to loadEnv(mode, cwd, ['REACT_APP_','VITE_']).
/app/frontend/.env was missing entirely; this is listed as a protected variable. Added with both REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and VITE_BACKEND_URL pointing at the public preview origin.
Dataset registry does not deduplicate repeat seeds; every click of Generate Demo creates a new UUID even though the content is identical (sales_performance.csv).
Preview endpoint relies on in-memory cache only — schema should be re-hydrated from disk on lookup to survive restarts.
endpoints.py is 891 lines — consider splitting by resource (datasets / analytics / chat / charts / settings) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Seed dataset created via POST /api/v1/datasets/seed-demo (sales_performance, 260 rows, 8 cols). Multiple duplicate entries exist due to repeated seed calls during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully wired; all /api/v1/* smoke endpoints pass. The only non-trivial frontend bug left is the Insights page auto-selecting a stale dataset on first load. Note that /chat-stream is a GET (not POST) with query params; /warehouse/query expects {sql, limit} (not {query}); /analytics/{id} is POST with {analysis_type, config}; /generate-insights/{id} is POST with {focus_columns, llm_provider, llm_model}.
rca_of_frontend_localhost_issue: Frontend built via Vite dev server. vite.config.ts resolved BACKEND_URL from process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, but Vite's dotenv loader does NOT export unprefixed (non-VITE_) vars into process.env — it only injects them into import.meta.env when loadEnv is called explicitly. Since /app/frontend/.env was also missing, BACKEND_URL fell back to 'http://localhost:8001' and was baked into the bundle via `define`. Browser then fetched http://localhost:8001/api/v1/datasets from the public https origin and Chrome blocked it with 'Permission denied for loopback address space' CORS error. Fixed by (a) creating /app/frontend/.env with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + VITE_BACKEND_URL set to the public origin, and (b) updating vite.config.ts to use loadEnv(mode, cwd, ['REACT_APP_','VITE_']).
